info.name: Indexing + Project Knowledge (Stage 1)
info.description:
Postman collection for:
1) POST /internal/v1/recommendations/submitprojectspecification — indexing + mandatory KG-1
2) POST /internal/v1/recommendations/project-knowledge/getassetrecommendations — Stage-1 multi-agent Q&A

**Import:** Collection + environment `Indexing-Pipeline-Local`.
**Server:** `uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload` from `haystack-fast-api/`.
**Files:** For multipart requests, attach fixtures from `postman/fixtures/`.

**Multi-agent:** Run request **15** (ingest) then **16** (query) so `ingestId` is saved.
Sessions are process-local; use the same server for both calls.
Default `PROJECT_AGENT_MODE=stub` (no LLM key required).

**Ingest success shape:** `ingest_id`, `data_kind`, `chunk_count`, `documents_written`, `kg_*`.
**Q&A success shape:** `answer`, `sources_used`, `tool_traces`, `research_hits`, `graph_hits`.
**Not returned on ingest:** `recommendation_id` / `results_by_need`.
